Typical considerations include, but are not limited t the following: effect on ambient noise level, on areas of unique interest or scenic beauty, on important recreational areas, on patterns of behavior for species, on wildlife breading, nesting, or feeding grounds, on air or water quality, on the water table of an area, etc. If possible, address comments to these considerations)
